contexts.text: Shall I hide from Abraham what I am doing? () = that nothing ought to be concealed before the Lord.
For in the other life no one can conceal what he is thinking.
However he may have concealed his thoughts before men...
The Angels do not at all want to conceal what they are thinking...
We will not hide it from the lord () = that it is known to the internal... The Natural has all that belongs to it from the internal, so that nothing can be concealed from it.
From his infancy man is accustomed... to conceal the real thoughts of his will...
These things are said of the day of visitation or judgment, when the iniquities of all shall be disclosed; which is meant by, The earth shall reveal her bloods, and shall no longer hide her slain ().
